heat!B33.v:
1. As a supplier of battery systems, during the discharge process, only the total electricity (kWh) and maximum power (current) are limited, and the provided heat dissipation power can only be evaluated based on the above working conditions.
2. Even if the project requirement is only 50% （50%DOD）of the currently configured electricity, since the battery system does not restrict the discharge time, there may be working conditions on-site where the battery is continuously discharged until the electricity is exhausted（100%DOD）.
3. In order to avoid abnormal temperature rise in the on-site space caused by heat accumulation, it is recommended that the on-site heat dissipation system be configured with reference to the battery system heat specified in the first clause. Unless the on-site conditions allow for restrictions on the battery discharge time.

heat!H33.v:
1、作为电池系统的供应商，放电过程中只有总电量（kWh）和最大功率（电流）有限制，所提供的散热功率只能以上述工况进行评估。
2、 即使项目需求仅为当前配置电量的 50%（50%DOD），由于电池系统不会对放电时间进行约束，而使用现场存在持续放电并将电量消耗殆尽（100%DOD）的工况。
3、为了避免使用现场空间积热导致空间温升异常，建议现场散热系统参考第一条的电池系统热量进行配置。除非使用现场有条件能对电池的放电时间进行约束。
